beats.anchor: Papa ferme les yeux. BriBri voudrait disparaître sous la table.
beats.extras: Monsieur Joseph Atéba, about 50: a tall Cameroonian man with dark brown skin, thin glasses, a salt and pepper mustache, a long black coat and a wool beanie striped green, red and yellow with a small embroidered star, a small black notebook in his hand, sitting with a paper cup of tea and a spoon, looking at Kaydoudou over his glasses, not angry at all, a hint of amusement under his mustache.
beats.outfit: BriBri (15): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, in a dark green Kingsbridge Albion tracksuit, hair still wet from the shower. Kaydoudou (13): a head shorter than his brother, round cheeks, soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, in the same tracksuit, hair still wet. Papa Armand: tall, short neat beard, warm eyes, a light blue shirt, a grey winter coat open over the shirt, his green, red and yellow knitted beanie in his hand.
beats.action: Kaydoudou, very serious, raises his hand like in class to ask his question. Monsieur Atéba looks at him over his thin glasses, spoon still in his tea. Papa has closed his eyes, one hand on his forehead. BriBri slides down in his chair, wishing he could disappear under the table.
beats.location: A small club café at a south London academy on a January afternoon: a plastic table with paper cups of tea, a steamed up window onto a wet car park, a counter with a hot water urn behind.
beats.light: Grey winter daylight from the window, warm fluorescent light inside.
beats.camera: Medium shot across the table at seated height, Kaydoudou's raised hand at the centre, Atéba on one side, Papa and BriBri on the other.
beats.alt: Au café du club, Kaydoudou lève la main pour demander à Monsieur Atéba s'il est un espion ; Papa ferme les yeux et BriBri voudrait disparaître sous la table.

beats.anchor: Ils font leur rituel. Poing contre poing. Main sur le cœur.
beats.outfit: BriBri (15): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, in a dark green tracksuit, the thick notebook covered in green and orange wax cloth closed on his knees. Kaydoudou (13): a head shorter than his brother, round cheeks, soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, in a dark green tracksuit top and jeans.
beats.action: On the last step of a very steep, narrow staircase, the two brothers sit squeezed shoulder to shoulder. Their fists touch, knuckle to knuckle, their other hands already moving to their hearts. BriBri, eyes still a little sad, is starting to smile at the corner of his mouth. Kaydoudou looks at him with a wise, mischievous grin, like a big brother for one evening.
beats.location: Inside a narrow terraced house in Lewisham, south London: a steep wooden staircase like a ladder between two close walls, worn carpet, a small framed photo on the wall, light rising from the kitchen below.
beats.light: Warm golden light coming up from the kitchen, the top of the stairs in soft shadow.
beats.camera: Quiet shot from a few steps below, looking up at the brothers framed by the two narrow walls.
beats.alt: Assis épaule contre épaule sur la dernière marche de l'escalier, les deux frères font leur rituel, poing contre poing.

beats.anchor: Mais il fait un tout petit signe de tête.
beats.extras: Monsieur Joseph Atéba, about 50: a tall Cameroonian man with dark brown skin, thin glasses, a salt and pepper mustache, a long black coat and a wool beanie striped green, red and yellow with a small embroidered star, a small black notebook in his hand, outside under a big black umbrella in the car park, the notebook just closed, looking up at the window. Behind BriBri, blurred, Freddie Shaw, 14, the goalkeeper: a very tall, gangly white English boy (1.80 m) with copper red hair, freckles all the way up to his eyelids, ears that turn red, extremely long arms singing with his arms up and Theo, 15: a tall white English striker with short fair hair banging on a locker, with other teammates jumping.
beats.outfit: BriBri (15): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion kit with white sleeves with the white number 8, soaked with rain.
beats.action: BriBri stands at the fogged dressing room window, one hand flat on the glass where he has wiped a clear patch. Outside, Monsieur Atéba does not smile, but he gives a tiny nod toward him. Behind BriBri, the whole team is celebrating.
beats.location: The Kingsbridge Albion dressing room window looking onto a wet car park on a white winter afternoon: parked cars, puddles, a fence.
beats.light: Cold white daylight outside, warm yellow light inside, raindrops on the glass.
beats.camera: Over the shoulder shot from behind BriBri, through the wiped patch of glass to the small, still figure of Atéba under his umbrella.
beats.alt: Par la fenêtre embuée du vestiaire, BriBri voit Monsieur Atéba, sous son parapluie noir, lui faire un tout petit signe de tête.
